en: Solids are not usually developmentally ready yet; focus on milk feeding and growth.
Watch for readiness later: sitting with support, good head control, and interest in food.
Ask your clinician before starting early.

fr: Proposez un repas d’essai calme à la fois.
Gardez les textures sûres et surveillées.
Faites une pause et demandez conseil si une réaction inquiète.
Gardez les séances courtes et proches du parent.
tr: Her seferinde sakin bir öğün denemesi sunun.
